item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 11/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and the weather will be very hot over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. High temperatures will also trigger showers. Upper-air disturbances will bring a few showers to Guangdong over the weekend. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the seas near Luzon early to midweek next week. An area of low pressure may also form over the trough of low pressure. Meanwhile, a weak northeast monsoon will affect southern China. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Bebinca will move towards the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands and intensify gradually in the next couple of days.
